overviewParagraphs: Bangkok Golf Club offers one of the most genuinely unique golf experiences available in Southeast Asia — professional-standard night golf under full floodlighting, enabling Bangkok visitors to play a proper 18-hole round after dinner or extend a late arrival day into a quality golf experience that no daytime schedule could accommodate. It is a testament to Thailand's creative approach to golf business that a city course has invested fully in this format.

The daytime course is strategically interesting in its own right — multiple water hazards thread through the layout requiring accurate approaches and disciplined shot selection, and the greens are consistently well-paced. But the night golf experience is what distinguishes Bangkok Golf Club from every other course in the city, and it is the reason AGS recommends it to international groups with tight Bangkok schedules.

For groups flying into Bangkok's Don Mueang Airport or staying in the northern city districts, Bangkok Golf Club is conveniently positioned and offers exceptional value combined with a truly memorable evening experience. There is no global equivalent of night golf quite like it — experiencing it in Bangkok is worth the round fee alone for the novelty and genuine enjoyment it delivers.

curatorBriefHtml: Bangkok Golf Club (opened 1993 in Pathum Thani, roughly 35–45 minutes north of central Bangkok near Don Mueang Airport) is Bangkok’s premier venue for floodlit championship night golf. Measuring 6,268 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the layout is defined by its famous island-green par-3 11th, swift undulating greens, and water coming into play on nearly every hole.

For international golfers arriving in Bangkok during the hot March–October months — or groups wanting to sightsee or attend business meetings by day and tee off at 5:00 PM in cool evening air — Bangkok Golf Club’s high-powered LED lighting delivers crisp ball visibility until 10:00 PM with a lively, atmospheric finish.

Because Bangkok Golf Club sits only 20 minutes from Don Mueang Airport (DMK) and 40 minutes from Sukhumvit, AGS slots it smoothly as an arrival-evening night round alongside daytime championship tests at Thai Country Club and Alpine Golf Club.

scorecard.verdict: An established Bangkok favorite featuring one of Thailand's most dramatic island greens on the par-3 17th. Excellent night golf facilities for after-work rounds.

faqs.q: How late can you play night golf at Bangkok Golf Club?
faqs.a: Floodlit tee times typically run from 4:30 PM through 7:00 PM, with full 18-hole lighting operational until roughly 10:00 PM — allowing a relaxed evening round well away from Bangkok’s daytime heat.

faqs.q: What is the signature hole at Bangkok Golf Club?
faqs.a: The par-3 11th plays to a dramatic, nerve-testing island green surrounded completely by water — especially theatrical under floodlights at night.

faqs.q: How far is Bangkok Golf Club from downtown Bangkok?
faqs.a: Roughly 35 to 45 minutes north of central Bangkok via expressway (and 20 minutes from Don Mueang Airport), depending on late-afternoon city traffic.

faqs.q: Is Bangkok Golf Club playable for mid-handicap groups?
faqs.a: Yes — at 6,268 yards from the Blue Tees (and shorter White Tees), length isn’t intimidating, though smart club selection around water hazards is essential.
